name: Grade 9 IIT Practice: August Week 12 - Presentation
description: Practice words for Grade 9 second-trimester Python and data work.

words.definition: A structured explanation of the question, method, chart, conclusion, and recommendation.
words.example: The presentation showed the question, chart, conclusion, and recommendation.

words.definition: A command that performs an action on data.
words.example: The student explained the method used to collect the survey data.

words.definition: A selected data visual used to explain the main finding to an audience.
words.example: The chart helped the audience see the main data pattern quickly.

words.definition: Advice about what should be done.
words.example: The recommendation told the school which option the data supported.
The final product combined the cleaned data, chart, and written explanation.

words.definition: A project note explaining evidence, limitations, and the next improvement.
words.example: The reflection described one improvement the group would make next time.
